description: This PHP class represents the model for Employee Education in the OrangeHRM system API. It serializes an EmployeeEducation entity for API responses, defining properties like institute, major, year, score, start and end dates, and related education info.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes EmployeeEducation entities for API responses, mapping properties and related data.
